scope: 950 valid existing IB Diploma Programme schools in the frozen national research universe

benchmarkDefinitions.national: Frozen national K=10 structural/locale benchmark; exact charter, adaptive grade configuration, six standardized structural dimensions, 0.5 broad-locale mismatch penalty.
benchmarkDefinitions.stateReadiness: Current frozen-rules K=10 state-local benchmark; same state, exact charter, adaptive grade configuration, six structural dimensions plus within-state readiness z, 0.5 locale penalty; only where supportable.
benchmarkDefinitions.commonAssessment: Strict ACT-family v5 or exact saved Indiana SAT-family pilot benchmark where available; never combined with other views.

p75Definition: 75th percentile of the ten peer IB participation rates. It is a descriptive peer-achievable benchmark, not a forecast or capacity ceiling.
equivalentGapDefinition: max(0, peer P75 - observed participation) × grades 9-12 enrollment. Interpret as an equivalent enrollment difference, not a forecast.
